what: S7 PR #10 CI failed at 'Contract tests (real app)': the app did not start because the staff middleware needs NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and scripts/contracts-run.mjs did not set it. I had run vitest, e2e and pgTAP locally but not npm run test:contracts:app, which CI runs.
rule: Before opening a PR run every command the CI workflow runs, in CI order, not a subset.
fix: Set the anon key in contracts-run.mjs; ran the full CI command list locally before pushing.
